function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 2015 年的國際象棋世界錦標賽（World Chess Championship 2015）由挪威棋手馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）贏得。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want the winner of the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Or maybe the 2015 World Chess Championship? The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could refer to the Chess Olympiad or the World Chess Championship. In Chinese, "國際象棋錦標賽" could mean "International Chess Championship". But likely they refer to the 2015 World Chess Championship. The 2015 World Chess Championship was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Alternatively, if it's the Chess Olympiad 2015, the winner was Russia. But the question: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" I'd answer: Magnus Carlsen. Provide answer in Chinese.
